name: Duotone Image Filter Tool
author: Claxton

sections.description:
This image filter plugin provides a powerful and intuitive interface for applying two-color (duotone) effects to your images without leaving WordPress. This streamlined process means you don’t need external software like Photoshop for these stylish edits.

Key Features:

Live Preview: See the duotone effect applied to your image instantly.

Color Pickers: Easily select your highlight and shadow colors.

Preset Library: Save your favorite color combinations as presets for quick and consistent styling across your site.

Drag & Drop: Upload images by dragging them directly into the editor.

Media Library Integration: Select existing images from your WordPress Media Library.

Fine-tune Adjustments: Control brightness, contrast, and saturation to perfect your final image.

Save to Library: Save your newly created duotone image directly to the Media Library.

This tool is perfect for bloggers, designers, and site owners who want to create a unique and consistent visual identity for their brand.
sections.installation:
Upload the duotone folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Navigate to the “Duotone” menu item in your WordPress admin dashboard to start creating!
sections.faq:
What image formats are supported?

The plugin currently supports JPEG and PNG image formats for processing.

Where are my saved images stored?

When you click “Save to Media Library,” the processed image is saved just like any other uploaded image and can be found in your WordPress Media Library.

Can I use this on the front-end of my site?

Currently, Duotone Image Filter Tool is an admin tool designed for preparing images before you add them to posts or pages.
